reference_roles.role: Existing church identity, projection and style

whole_scene_prompt:
Use case: sketch-to-render.
Asset type: COMPLETE GAME LEVEL BACKGROUND, phase 1 church courtyard for Plaguefall, an existing Sega Mega Drive pixel-art game. This is the first full-scene master to be evaluated before extracting any modules.
Input images: image 1 is the user's composition blueprint (top band, bottom band, narrow left/right boundaries, four whole field obstacles); image 2 is the current church level and is the mandatory architecture, camera angle, color and style reference.
Primary request: translate that blueprint into ONE cohesive finished whole playable courtyard scene, landscape4:3, ideally1536x1152 corresponding to a512x384 native level. The scene itself must fill the entire image, no margins, no frame, no labels, no diagram panels, no text, no HUD, no characters or insects.
Composition in logical512x384 pixels:
UPPER AREA y0..111: preserve the recognizable existing humble northeastern Brazilian Catholic church at x24..216, cream plaster, terracotta sloping roof, small blue windows and blue door, and small bell gable. Keep the whole church silhouette and roof inside this band. Continue its boundary naturally to a blue evacuation gate at x376..472, with masonry and restrained vegetation behind the wall. The TOP BAND must read as one continuous complete architectural edge, never bits of facades.
LOWER AREA y352..383: a complete continuous low cream masonry wall with terracotta cap, visually front-facing to the player, with its own visible top ledge and coherent contact shadow. This is a purpose-drawn foreground wall, NOT a cropped strip of the church facade. It connects cleanly to both corners.
LATERAL LIMITS x0..23 and488..511, y112..351: uninterrupted matching low walls in the same oblique top-down projection. Design both lower corner junctions correctly. Reuse consistent masonry units; do not mirror directional lighting.
PLAY FIELD x24..487,y112..351: quiet warm ochre earth with subtle sparse texture, generously open for a90second introductory combat with one enemy type. Exactly FOUR small low obstacles with clear floor support and short coherent contact shadows: complete wooden bench at x128..191,y168..199; a compact pair of blue storage barrels at x344..391,y208..239; the SAME complete wooden bench motif at x152..215,y280..311; the SAME compact blue barrel pair at x344..391,y296..327. Nothing else loose in the play field. Keep each object whole and fully detached from the walls, with empty space around it. Keep the center and the route to the upper gate open.
Style: crisp deliberately restrained16bit pixel art, match the provided current game image, small limited earthy ochre/cream/terracotta/blue palette. Clear silhouette at512x384. Stable material scale and common light from upper-left. Bench and barrel duplicates should use identical scale and orientation. Structure and repeated units must be harmonious and terminate with actual corner/end pieces.
Avoid: overhead labels, arrows, wireframe, conceptual gray blocks, transparency, photorealism, gradients, excessive grit, scattered rubble, extra buildings, unanchored sprites, floating items, incomplete roofs, cut pillars, cropped benches, alternating inconsistent perspective, straight hard cut shadows, thick decorative frame. Make the whole scene first.
native_preparation: Whole church and evacuation gate reused from current phase1 to preserve identity. Complete generated benches/barrels and lower/lateral boundary modules extracted; material repetition reduced to fit both states. No fuzzy tile replacement.
